input: How do parents view student grades and attendance on Alma LMS?
retrieved_context: Alma LMS features a dedicated Parent and Student Portal accessible via web or the AlmaNow mobile app.
Parents can log in to view real-time gradebook updates, assignment due dates, daily classroom attendance, and term report cards.
expected_output: Parents can view real-time grades and attendance by logging into the Alma Parent Portal web interface or using the AlmaNow mobile application.

input: Can I return an opened laptop after 20 days?
retrieved_context: Electronics and computers must be returned within 14 days of purchase with a valid receipt.
Opened electronic items are subject to a 15% restocking fee upon return.
expected_output: No, laptops cannot be returned after 20 days because the return window for electronics is 14 days.

input: Why was a $5 maintenance fee charged to my account?
retrieved_context: A $5 monthly account maintenance fee applies if the daily average balance drops below $1,000 during the billing cycle.
Fees are waived for accounts with active direct deposit.
expected_output: The $5 fee was applied because your daily balance fell below $1,000 without an active direct deposit.
